description: Get the seller's combined-shipping configuration for one marketplace (Account API v2 getCombinedShippingRules): calculated, flat and promotional rules, handling rule, and the combined payment window. Rule IDs returned here are needed by the update tools. marketplaceId is sent as the required X-EBAY-C-MARKETPLACE-ID header. Requires sell.account.readonly or sell.account.

marketplaceId.description: eBay marketplace sent as the required X-EBAY-C-MARKETPLACE-ID header, e.g. EBAY_US

name: ebay_get_combined_shipping_rules
